heading: Looking for Sites for New Projects
description: KAN Development is looking for land for residential and commercial projects in order to develop its business.
location: Location of plots: Kyiv, without restrictions.
offers: Send your proposals with a package of documents to

documents.title: Package of documents required for consideration
docs: Copy of title documents to the land plot
Withdrawal from the State Land Cadastre of Land
Location of the site on the map of Kyiv
Map or layout of the site with links to adjacent streets (on a large scale)
Indication of the presence / absence of engineering communications at the site, map / scheme of communications at a scale of 1: 500 with their application (if any)
Commercial proposal indicating the terms of the transfer of rights
Sketch, concept, pre-project or project (if available)
